verdict.rationale: The Claude API lets callers name an optional `version` when specifying a Skill, and there is a Skill Versions API for version management. Plugins carry a version in their manifest and are framed as versioned releases. However, Claude Code marketplaces advertise automatic updates, and nothing documents a lockfile or a way to pin or freeze plugin and skill updates for a team. missing for 10: a lockfile or pinning mechanism for Claude Code plugins and skills, documented control over disabling marketplace automatic updates, detail on API version-pinning semantics (e.g. default-to-latest behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can control when skill changes reach my team — pinned versions or a lockfile rather than silent behind-the-back updates
